description: x402 endpoint validator and payment-readiness checker, useful for sellers debugging a paywall or buyers vetting an endpoint before paying. Fetches the URL unpaid, decodes the 402 challenge and grades network, USDC asset, payTo, price vs facilitator fees, EIP-712 domain, CORS and Bazaar metadata. Returns a 0-100 score and a fix list. Never pays the target. Errors: 400 JSON {error} for invalid input. PAID: $0.02 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/x402/check.

url.description: https URL of the x402-protected endpoint
